source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001]
Before I hire you, I’d like to verify that you can assist with this specific problem.

My Meta ad account is [ACCOUNT_001] to run ads. Meta initially told me that 2FA was required, even though my personal account already has two-step authentication verified and I have run Facebook ads successfully before.

Meta support now says the problem is associated with my personal Facebook profile rather than the ad account, citing “account integrity/authentic identity.”

Have you previously resolved this exact kind of Meta restriction at the profile level?

value_updates.access_goal: restore the ability to run advertisements through the existing Meta ad account
value_updates.restriction_to_resolve: personal Facebook profile restriction associated with account integrity or authentic identity

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Yes, we’re already aware of that. [CLIENT_NAME_002], explain to them that it won’t allow us to disable it completely.

execution.observed_behavior: The existing profile would not allow two-factor authentication to be disabled completely, blocking Meta support's proposed off-and-on reset workaround.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: No alternative solution exists. I’m ending the contract now, and you’ll receive a refund for the full amount. I’m sorry that we were [ACCOUNT_001] to accomplish the goal.

execution.observed_behavior: The freelancer reported that only Meta support could remove the backend restriction and that no alternative restoration solution was available.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: They brought it up during the call. Since more than 180 days have passed, it can’t be fixed. That is the period allowed for an appeal.

execution.observed_behavior: After the escalated support attempt, Meta's stated appeal period had expired and the existing-account restriction could not be fixed.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yes. We can set it up this weekend.

value_updates.alternate_account_route: Set up the previously discussed other Facebook account as an alternate account.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001], what do I need to prepare for our call? What would I need to get from my sister to use her account for running my ads? Please confirm how we would do this. Thanks for your help.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hey [CLIENT_NAME_002].

We need pictures of the front and back of her ID, taken against a dark background.

value_updates.identity_document_images: Pictures of the front and back of the sister's ID taken against a dark background.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Yes. Log in to her account from your computer. If she hasn’t already, ask her to turn on 2 Factor authentication.

value_updates.two_factor_authentication: Enable two-factor authentication on the sister's account if it is not already enabled.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: We won’t need her after that. We’ll add another email so that you can also access the account. Yes, I’ll manage your campaigns without involving her afterward. She’ll only be needed for the first meeting to give us the two-factor authentication codes.

value_updates.client_access_method: Add another email so the client can access the account.
value_updates.sister_involvement_after_initial_setup: The sister is not required after the first meeting.
value_updates.initial_sister_role: Provide two-factor authentication codes during the first meeting.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Would you have any interest in managing my Facebook Ads? I was informed that I could grant someone administrator rights so they could manage them on my behalf.

value_updates.campaign_management: manage the client's Facebook advertising campaigns on the client's behalf

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: We won’t need her after that. We’ll add another email so that you can also access the account. Yes, I’ll manage your campaigns without involving her afterward. She’ll only be needed for the first meeting to give us the two-factor authentication codes.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: When I’m ready to proceed with Facebook ads, I’ll contact you again. I’d like your help with them in the near future.

decisions.reason: Establishing the sister's account as the alternate route does not explicitly modify or remove the separate existing-account restoration requirement.
The account used to obtain advertising access does not change the existing requirement to manage the client's campaigns on the client's behalf.
The identity-document images are required for the sister's alternate-account route and do not change the separate requirement to restore access through the client's existing restricted Meta account.
Preparing identity-document images for alternate-account access does not change the requirement to manage the client's Facebook advertising campaigns.
The login-device and two-factor-authentication instructions apply to the sister's alternate account, not restoration of access through the client's existing restricted Meta account.
The alternate-account access setup may enable later campaign management, but it does not change the current requirement to manage the client's Facebook advertising campaigns.
The alternate-account access arrangement does not change the existing-account restoration goal or its profile-level restriction.

The campaign-management impact is already fully represented by the same-message MODIFY stating that ongoing sister participation is not required; the remaining details concern alternate-account access setup.

The candidate already has a complete message-111 MODIFY recording the added client email, the sister's limited initial role, and that her involvement is not required after setup; no additional update or removal is needed.
The decision concerns ongoing campaign management through the alternate account and does not change or remove the separate goal of restoring access through the existing Meta account.
